name: library
description: Every workflow in the library, each with an example chosen from research into what its model is actually good at (model cards, papers, official prompting guides, ComfyUI template notes) — a smoke test that doubles as the library's showcase. Pictures made from words feed the edits, the 3D cards, the captioner and the videos; real photos and real footage are used where a card's power only shows on them (restoring damage, copying a dancer's moves). Each run's note says what to look at. Settings are each card's defaults except prompts and inputs, unless the run keeps its calibrated timing (keepRuntime).

runs.note: One sentence per object and every word in quotes: all six labels on this desk are written exactly, and each object sits where the prompt put it. It was drawn at the model's native 2K size, so zoom in on the small print.

params.textencodeqwenimage21_prompt_459_452: Overhead flat-lay photograph, shot from directly above, of a tidy design student's desk: a pale birch-plywood tabletop in soft north-window daylight. In the top left corner, a closed black hardback sketchbook whose cover reads "SKETCHBOOK 2026" in white sans-serif capitals. In the top right corner, a white ceramic coffee cup on a saucer, wrapped in a kraft-paper sleeve printed "AGORA CAFÉ". In the centre, an open A5 notebook showing a pencil sketch of a wooden chair, with the handwritten note "chair v3 - lower the back 2 cm" under the drawing. On the left edge, a round metal tin of pencils with a label reading "HB 2B 4B 6B". In the bottom right corner, a square red sticky note with the handwritten words "crit at 10:30". Along the bottom edge, a steel ruler with centimetre marks numbered 0 to 15. A yellow pencil and two black binder clips lie between the objects. Crisp detail, natural colours, soft gentle shadows, realistic photograph.

runs.note: A close-up is where this card earns its extra time: count the fingers, read the numerals I to XII and the word GENÈVE on the dial. Re-run it with Fix strength at 0 (same seed) to see what the add-on itself changes.

params.textencodeqwenimage21_prompt_459_452: Macro photograph of a watchmaker's hands repairing an open gold pocket watch on a dark green leather work mat. The white enamel dial shows black Roman numerals from I to XII and the word "GENÈVE" in small capitals under the XII, with blued steel hands at ten past ten. A brass loupe and two tiny screws lie beside the watch. Warm desk-lamp light from the upper left, shallow depth of field, crisp detail, natural skin texture with fine creases on the knuckles.

runs.note: A photo made from text alone. Look closely at the skin — pores, freckles, fine hairs — and at the sweater, whose colour was given as the code #1F5C4A.

params.prompt: Studio photograph, full-length shot at eye level against a seamless light-grey paper backdrop, under soft, even light from a large softbox at frame-left with a gentle fill from the right. A young West African woman in her twenties with dark brown skin and short natural coily black hair dyed copper at the tips stands upright in the centre of the frame, facing the camera, her arms relaxed slightly away from her body and her feet a little apart, the whole figure from head to sneakers in frame with space above and below. She wears round tortoiseshell glasses, a mustard-yellow cotton utility jumpsuit with rolled sleeves, a zipped chest pocket and a row of small brass snaps, a teal canvas tool belt with three pouches across her hips, and white high-top canvas sneakers with red laces. A small coral-red backpack with two padded straps sits on her shoulders. Her expression is calm, with a slight closed-mouth smile. A soft contact shadow pools on the grey floor around her feet, and the background is an even, featureless light grey.

params.instruction_1:
Look carefully at this image and answer in five numbered sections.
1. What it is, in one sentence.
2. Text: copy every piece of text you can see exactly as written (same spelling, capitals and accents), one item per line, each followed by where it is (top, centre, bottom, left, right). If there is no text, say so.
3. Translation: translate any text that is not in English into English.
4. Design: three or four short bullet points on the layout, the colour palette, the typography and the illustration style.
5. Prompt: one paragraph that could be given to an image generator to recreate this image.
Describe only what you can see; do not invent details.

params.minimaxh3imagetovideo_prompt_11:
integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Live-action, cinematic, a medium shot in a white-tiled subway corridor at rush hour. A young street drummer in a red beanie and a faded denim jacket sits on a low wooden crate behind three upturned white plastic buckets and a dented metal pot lid, a drumstick in each hand. He plays a fast, tight beat: the right stick strikes the big centre bucket on every beat with a deep hollow boom, the left stick snaps against the bucket rims with sharp plastic clicks and hits the pot lid with a bright metallic clang on the off-beat, his shoulders bouncing in time. At about two seconds he twirls the left stick between his fingers without missing a beat and then hits the pot lid twice, hard. Commuters in coats stream past behind him, slightly out of focus, and one of them tosses a coin into the open instrument case at his feet. The camera pushes in with small amplitude at slow speed from waist height, ending on his hands and the buckets.

overall_soundscape: The drum hits echo off the tiled walls over a steady murmur of the crowd and hurried footsteps; a coin clinks into the case, and a train rumbles through the station in the distance.

non_diegetic_music: N/A

runs.note: Ten seconds, three shots and a narrator, all from one prompt. Notice where the cuts fall (about 4 and 7.5 seconds, as written) and that the voice-over and the music were generated with the pictures.

params.minimaxh3imagetovideo_prompt_105_104:
integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Live-action nature documentary, cinematic, soft blue dawn light. A wide aerial shot glides slowly forward over a misty pine forest in a deep valley; low clouds drift between the treetops and a silver river winds along the valley floor. The camera pushes in with small amplitude at slow speed. A calm, deep male narrator (S1) says in an off-screen voiceover: <d>[English] Every morning, the valley wakes up slowly.</d> [Shot 2] At 00:04.000, the camera cuts to a close-up of a red fox stepping out of the ferns onto a mossy fallen log, its breath steaming in the cold air; it stops and lifts its head toward the light. The camera holds a static shot. [Shot 3] At 00:07.500, the camera cuts to a low wide shot over the river, where mist rolls across the water and the first golden sunbeams break through the pines. The narrator (S1) continues in the same off-screen voiceover: <d>[English] And then, the light arrives.</d> The camera tilts up with small amplitude at slow speed toward the rising sun.

overall_soundscape: Soft forest dawn ambience with distant birdsong, a light breeze in the pines, the crunch of moss and twigs under the fox's paws, and the gentle rush of the river.
